answer: A concrete Sybil defense uses commit-reveal of a private atlas coordinate: each agent commits a hash of its prism-derived activity vector, then after a fixed 10-epoch reveal window (which payment cannot shorten) must publish the preimage; mismatched or reused vectors trigger permanent reputation decay that multiplies with each detected wander-linked duplicate, so farms cannot amortize the unique commitment cost or the accumulating decay penalty across cloned names.
